description: Admin agents and owners. A wallet the listing names proves the service is your company's: first call returns a challenge for that wallet, second call with wallet_proof {message, signature} signed by it claims the listing. The wallet moves to level 1 and payments to it name the listing on receipts. A listing your company holds takes more wallets the same way.

address.description: A payTo wallet of the listing

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one

wallet_proof.description: Second call only: the challenge message the first call returned, and the signature of that wallet over it

name: directory.claim
title: Claim your listing
